pages.text: [#](53341a)This additive endgame working carries a settled home bodily between the waking world and the Spirit World. Brew and bottle an Otherwhere Hearth, then use it on an empty, dry Kettle. The Kettle binds permanently to the witch who named it.[#]()
pages.title: The Otherwhere Hearth

pages.text: [#](53341a)To cross, draw a **large Otherwhere ring** and a **medium Ritual ring** around the block beneath the Kettle.[#]()
[#](53341a)Gather six coven witches and a complete altar inside the hearth, fill that altar with at least 10,000 power, then crouch and touch the bound Kettle with an empty hand.[#]()

[#](53341a)The hearth is a **25 x 25 x 25** volume: twelve blocks outward from the Kettle in every horizontal direction, eight below it, and sixteen above. The same coordinates in the Overworld and Spirit World exchange places. Blocks, block entities, and every movable entity inside both volumes travel with them.[#]()
pages.title: Otherwhere Hearth

pages.text: [#](53341a)Brew **Soul of Torment**, **Demon Heart**, **Brew of Sleeping**, **Spirit of Otherwhere**, **Charged Attuned Stone**, and **Drop of Luck** in that order. The batch needs 10,000 altar power and yields one binding draught.[#]()
pages.title: Kettle: Otherwhere Hearth

pages.text: [#](53341a)This is a true swap, not an erasure. The far volume returns to the place the house left, and the same bound Kettle performs the return journey.[#]()
pages.title: A Hearth Must Arrive Safely

pages.text: [#](53341a)The rite refuses to begin if a player occupies the destination, a sleeping dream-traveller or unmovable entity is caught inside, either volume crosses a world border or protected claim, an unbreakable block or another bound hearth is present, or the[#]()
[#](53341a)circles, coven, altar strength, or available power are incomplete.[#]() [#](53341a)Both volumes and every non-player traveller are recorded before anything is changed.[#]()
[#](53341a)If the server stops during the crossing, the saved working resumes until the hearth settles and charges the travelling altar exactly once.[#]()
[#](53341a)The structures may settle while a traveller is offline, but that witch remains in the manifest and is delivered before the record clears.[#]()
[#](53341a)Witches carried bodily into the Spirit World keep their inventory and face ordinary death there; this is not dream walking.[#]()
